name: css-compass
description: Go to definition, hover and completion for CSS Modules, global classes and custom properties.

scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm check:size && vsce package --no-dependencies

cssCompass.sources.markdownDescription: CSS files whose custom properties and global classes are indexed: globs relative to the workspace folder (`src/**/*.css`) or package specifiers (`@acme/design-system/style.css`). When not set: `src/**/*.css` plus `cssVariables.lookupFiles`.

cssCompass.classFunctions.markdownDescription: Functions whose string arguments, array items and object keys are class names, e.g. `clsx("font-size_s", { active: isActive })`.

cssCompass.localsConvention.markdownDescription: How CSS Module class names map to JS names. Use the same value as `css.modules.localsConvention` in your Vite config.

cssCompass.diagnostics.unknownModuleClas.markdownDescription: Warn about `styles.x` when `.x` doesn't exist in the imported `.module.css` file.

cssCompass.diagnostics.unknownGlobalClas.markdownDescription: Warn about class names in `className` strings and class functions that no CSS source defines. Off by default: classes from CSS outside `cssCompass.sources` are flagged too.

cssCompass.debug.timings.description: Log how long each request takes to the "CSS Compass" output channel.
